name: Pancake Breakfast
summary: The Hanceville Civitan Club is flipping pancakes for the community on Saturday morning. It is a delicious way to start the weekend and support a local service club.

name: Bats, Bats and More Bats!
host: Southern Ghost Girls Tours and Paranormal Investigations, Hanceville Public Library and Lesley Bearden Hyde
summary: A local Boy Scout shares how bats help our ecosystem. Come learn why these night flyers deserve a little more love this spooky season.

name: Rastelli Circus
summary: The Rastelli Family Circus rolls into town for one day with stunts, carnival rides, live music and fair food. Bring the whole family and your loudest gasps.

name: Blakgraz Live at Ethos Craft Brewing
summary: Blakgraz plays three hours of original songs across many genres, with giveaways along the way. Food and drinks are available on site.

name: Singo Bingo
summary: Music bingo meets ice cream, with prizes on the line. Name that tune, mark your card and treat yourself to a scoop.

name: Beauty and the Beast JR.
cost: Tickets online or at the door; children 3 and under free
summary: Cullman Community Theatre presents a youth production of Disney's Beauty and the Beast JR. Be our guest and cheer on these talented young performers.

name: Bone Yard Bash at 91 Short Track
host: Courtney Lynn Connors and Arab Blount Cullman Yardsale
summary: The second annual Bone Yard Bash brings racing with cash payouts, free kids Hot Wheels races, and pumpkin and costume contests. Start your engines and your costumes.

name: Murder at Jubilee Manor: Murder Mystery Dinner
summary: Enjoy dinner while you follow the clues and solve the case. Ticket and menu details are coming soon, so keep your detective hat handy.

name: Uganda Spaghetti Fundraiser
cost: $12 per plate; buy tickets by Oct 28
summary: Dine in or carry out a spaghetti dinner that supports the church's 2027 medical mission trip to Uganda. Good food for a great cause.

name: Sawdust Jukebox Live at Goat Island Brewing
summary: Sawdust Jukebox plays a four hour Friday night set of classic and 90s country. Dust off those boots.

name: Drive Through Trick or Treat
summary: Hanceville firefighters and EMTs hand out candy to kids right from their cars for the sixth year. Costumes are encouraged and seatbelts are required.

name: Alabama's Fall Festival and Pumpkin Patch
summary: Pumpkins, hayrides, a corn maze, rides, farm animals and food make this a fall favorite. Pick your perfect pumpkin before the season slips away.

name: Cullman Veterans Day Celebration
summary: Honor our veterans with warbirds, skydivers, military flyovers, living history and special guest Mike Durant. The celebration happens rain or shine.

name: Cullman Christmas Open House
host: Cullman Area Chamber of Commerce and Visitor Center
summary: Kick off holiday shopping with business promotions, a cookie crawl, visits from Santa and a window display contest. Your wish list just found its weekend.
